ModMetadata.Name: Inventory Peek
ModMetadata.Author: XCeled
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Keep your inventory open without it in the way[/h1] Mark the inventory windows you use most as hidable. They disappear while you play and come back the instant you hold [b]Alt[/b] to use the cursor, exactly where you left them. Leave everything open and still see the world.
[hr][/hr] [h2]How it works[/h2] [list] [*]Every inventory window gets an [b]eye[/b] button on its title bar. Click it to make that window hidable; click it again to keep it always visible. [*]While you play, a hidable window is invisible and clicks pass straight through it. [*]Hold [b]Alt[/b] and every hidden window shows at once, ready to use. It is the game's Mouse Control key, so if you rebind that, the mod follows. Other screens that free the cursor leave hidden windows hidden. [*][b]Double press Alt[/b] quickly to latch every hidden window on, so you can keep them in view while you play. Double press again to hide them. [*]The choice is per window: hiding your backpack's window does not hide another backpack's. It is remembered across sessions, separately for each save. [*]A drag that starts while you hold Alt keeps the window up until you let go. [/list]
[hr][/hr] [h2]Settings[/h2] In the StationeersLaunchPad config editor, or the config file [i]net.xceled.stationeers.inventorypeek.cfg[/i]: [table] [tr][th]Setting[/th][th]Default[/th][th]What it does[/th][/tr] [tr][td][b]Enabled[/b][/td][td]on[/td][td]Off shows every window as the game does.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][b]HiddenOpacity[/b][/td][td]0[/td][td]How visible a hidden window stays: 0 is invisible, 0.2 leaves a faint outline.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][b]ToggleKey[/b][/td][td]none[/td][td]Optional key that toggles the window under the cursor while Alt is held, instead of the eye.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][b]DoublePressSeconds[/b][/td][td]0.3[/td][td]How quick a double press of Alt must be to latch windows on or off. 0 turns the latch off.[/td][/tr] [tr][td][b]HidableWindows[/b][/td][td]empty[/td][td]The windows you have marked, one line per save. The eye button keeps it up to date.[/td][/tr] [/table]
[hr][/hr] [h2]Removing it[/h2] Nothing is stored in your save, so you can disable or remove it at any time. Every window simply shows again.
[hr][/hr] [h2]Good to know[/h2] [list] [*]The windows themselves are untouched: they stay open, docked or undocked, exactly as the game has them. Slot hotkeys, sort, dock and close all work as usual, hidden or not. [*]A hidden docked window keeps its place in the dock, so the dock shows a gap where it is. [*]The game's own [b]`[/b] key is different: it closes every window, and you reopen each one by hand. [*]Client side only: nothing is sent over the network, so it is safe in multiplayer and only you need it. [/list]
